lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: H1 sales are visible from the company's own 月次 at 全店 104.0% YoY (Q2: Jun 100.1, Jul 108.2, Aug 103.2), against an H1 plan of ¥126.0bn (+7.6%). Q1 OP was only +1.3% (¥7,953m), so Q2 OP would need ¥7,047m (+12.9% YoY) to reach the ¥15.0bn H1 plan. That is implausible with Aug store comps at 97.8% and 雑貨 below last year, so H1 OP lands near ¥13.9-14.3bn, a miss of about 5% against the plan and the first H1 miss against plan in the four years on record.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-07-07: OP +1.3% (a thin increase), stock -5.0% next day (kabutan/fisco 2026-07-08). H1 2025-10-07: OP 11% above the H1 plan, stock -8.1% next day. The quarter line has been sold whichever way it went.

findings.finding: The full-year decision is the real event. Holding the ¥29,400m OP plan implies H2 OP of about ¥15.1-15.5bn against ¥13,049m last year (+16-19%), and the street already sits at ¥28,433m (IFIS, 5 analysts, all rated 強気). The company's revision record over three years has no cut: it raised at H1 in Oct 2023 and Oct 2024, held at H1 in Oct 2025 despite an 11% H1 beat, and finished above plan. So a hold is a relief against the street bar, a trim to about ¥28.4bn is neutral, and only a cut below consensus is new bad news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-07, a first FY guide of +8.3% OP: +7.1% next day, given back the following day (kabutan 2026-04-08). 2025-10-07, FY held after an H1 beat: -8.1%. No forecast cut on record to read.

findings.finding: Peer read-through for the H2 narrative: アンドST (Adastria, same young-casual apparel segment and FY) reported September comps +8.8% on cool weather and strong autumn apparel (+2.1pt calendar), and United Arrows' comps rose for a 12th straight month in September. PAL's own August release says the H2 plan rests on new 雑貨 products, with headcount for them already added. That supports management holding the FY plan at this release; PAL's own September 月次 is not out until 10/26.

findings.finding: The FY plan looks beatable and the company has a habit of raising at Q3. It raised the full-year forecast at the Q3 print in FY2024 (24/10/09) and FY2025 (25/10/07; the stock rose +22.3% to the next close), and at Q2 this year. The 7/7 plan implies H2 OP of 562m, ~281m a quarter, below Q2's 303m, while Q2 revenue was still accelerating (+36.8% YoY) and Q4 has historically been at or above Q3. Against that, on 8/14 management called the plan 'neither optimistic nor overly conservative' and guided H2 personnel costs up.

findings.finding: The latest leg of the run-up has no revenue in it. The stock rose from 3,190 to 4,100 (+28.5%) over 9/29 to 10/02 on the Himeji school-board adoption, yet the plan lets a board open note pro for all its schools 一括して無料で (in one batch, free of charge).
